DIMANCER_FILES.Title: File Manager
DIMANCER_FILES.MakePrivate: Make this folder private (only GMs and assistants see it)
DIMANCER_FILES.MakePublic: Make this folder visible to players
DIMANCER_FILES.SearchResults: {n} results for “{query}” in this folder and below
DIMANCER_FILES.Details: Show or hide the details panel
DIMANCER_FILES.DropHint: Drop files or whole folders here to upload them.
DIMANCER_FILES.Tips: Double-click to open. Ctrl/Shift-click to select several. Del deletes, F2 renames, drag onto a folder to move.
DIMANCER_FILES.CompanionTip: To delete, rename and move files, install the companion service on the server (see the module README) and connect it (plug icon).
DIMANCER_FILES.NotUsed: No document in this world uses it.
DIMANCER_FILES.WorldOnly: Only world documents were checked. Turn on “Check compendiums” in the module settings to include compendiums.

Delete.Title: Delete
Delete.InUse: {n} document(s) still use these files and will show missing images or sounds:
Delete.PermanentConfirm: Delete {n} item(s) for good? They don't go to the trash and can't be restored.
Delete.TrashOnly: Items go to the trash, where they can be restored. This server doesn't allow permanent deletion from Foundry.

Move.Title: Move
Move.Label: Folder
Move.Hint: A folder inside the Data folder, e.g. assets/maps. It must exist.

Rewrite.Label: Update these documents to the new path
Rewrite.Done: Updated {n} document(s) to the new paths.

Trash.Title: Trash
Trash.Hint: Deleted files wait here until you empty the trash. It lives in the hidden Data/.dimancer-trash folder.
Trash.KeptDays: The companion deletes items for good {n} days after they were deleted.
Trash.RestoreAllConfirm: Put all {n} item(s) in the trash back where they were?
Trash.DeleteAllOff: This server doesn't allow deleting for good from Foundry (start the companion with ALLOW_PERMANENT=1), or empty the trash on the server: node server.mjs trash empty
Trash.EmptyConfirm: Delete all {n} item(s) in the trash for good? This can't be undone.
Trash.PurgeConfirm: Delete {n} item(s) from the trash for good?
Trash.ServerOnly: This server only empties the trash from its command line: node server.mjs trash empty

Upload.Rejected: Skipped {n} file(s) of a type that can't be uploaded here: {list}
Upload.Conflict: {n} file(s) already exist with the same name:

Error.BadFolderName: A folder name can't contain slashes or start with a dot.

Companion.Title: File companion
Companion.Hint: Delete, rename and move need the companion service, installed separately on the Foundry server. Set its address and log in here.
Companion.Explain: The companion is a small service you install separately on the Foundry server. Foundry itself can't delete, rename or move files. You log in with its secret once per session: the secret is never saved, and the login ends when you reload Foundry, log out, or it expires.
Companion.UrlHint: Leave empty when your reverse proxy serves it at /dimancer-files on this site. For local testing, e.g. http://localhost:30001.
Companion.Timeout: The companion didn't answer in time.
Companion.Unreachable: No companion answered at {url}. Check the Address (locally: http://localhost:30001) and that the companion's CORS_ORIGIN matches this page's address ({origin}).
Companion.NotCompanion: Something answered at {url}, but it isn't the companion. Locally, set the Address to http://localhost:30001.
Companion.Incompatible: This companion doesn't match this version of the module. Update the companion (or the module): {url}
Companion.LoggedInNote: Logged in to the file companion {version}.
Companion.SecretHint: Sent once to log in and never saved. The login lasts until you reload Foundry, log out, or the server's session time runs out.
Companion.LoginNeeded: Log in to the file companion first (plug icon in the file browser).
Companion.PolicyTrash: Deleting moves files to the trash; this server doesn't allow permanent deletion from Foundry.
Companion.OnOtherSource: Companion works on User Data only

ReplaceImages.Name: Use for image pickers
ReplaceImages.Hint: Image, texture and image-or-video fields (portraits, tokens, scene backgrounds, tile images…) open this browser. Off: Foundry's own picker.

ReplaceAudio.Name: Use for sound pickers
ReplaceAudio.Hint: Playlist sounds, ambient sounds and other audio fields.

ReplaceVideo.Name: Use for video pickers
ReplaceVideo.Hint: Video-only fields, e.g. journal video pages.

ReplaceOther.Name: Use for other file pickers
ReplaceOther.Hint: Fields that take any file, text or fonts (e.g. PDF journal pages).

ReplaceFolders.Name: Use for folder pickers
ReplaceFolders.Hint: Fields that ask for a folder rather than a file.

ReplaceTiles.Name: Use for the canvas Tile Browser
ReplaceTiles.Hint: Tiles tool → Browse. Drag images onto the canvas to place them as tiles at the chosen grid size.

ScanCompendiums.Name: Check compendiums
ScanCompendiums.Hint: When looking for documents that use a file (before delete, rename or move), also load every compendium. Slower.

DIMANCER_FILES.TilesHint: Drag an image or video onto the canvas to place it as a tile (Shift: no snapping, Alt: hidden).
